<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/guide.ts -->
<!--
  A long read: sections with headings, text and an optional pull quote, in one reading column or beside a table
  of contents that links to each section. Axes: layout (column, toc), quotes (show, hide), tone. Highlighting
  the section being read is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Section } from "./article-body.types";

  export type ArticleBodyProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    sections: Section[];
    tocTitle: string;
    layout?: "column" | "toc";
    quotes?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    sections,
    tocTitle,
    layout = "column",
    quotes = "show",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ArticleBodyProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Grid
    cols="1"
    class={cn(
      "items-start gap-8",
      (((layout as string) === "toc") ? "md:grid-cols-[14rem_minmax(0,1fr)]" : "")
    )}
  >
    {#if ((layout as string) === "toc")}
      <NavBlock
        label={(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl("{0}, {1}", tocTitle, landmarkLabel)) : tocTitle)}
        class="md:sticky md:top-4"
        testid="toc"
      >
        <Stack gap="2">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {tocTitle}
          </Text>
          <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
            {#each sections as s (s.id)}
              <ListItem>
                <Link
                  href={tpl("#{0}-{1}", id, s.id)}
                  variant="default"
                  class="text-sm text-muted-foreground"
                  data-testid="toc-link"
                >
                  {s.title}
                </Link>
              </ListItem>
            {/each}
          </List>
        </Stack>
      </NavBlock>
    {/if}
    <Stack gap="8" align="stretch" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-2xl min-w-0" data-testid="article">
      {#each sections as s (s.id)}
        <Box class="flex flex-col gap-4" id={tpl("{0}-{1}", id, s.id)} data-testid="item">
          <Title as={3} size="2xl" weight="bold">
            {s.title}
          </Title>
          <Text size="base">
            {s.text}
          </Text>
          {#if ((quotes as string) === "show")}
            {#if s.quote}
              <Text tag="blockquote" class="m-0 border-l border-border pl-4 text-lg" data-testid="quote">
                {s.quote}
              </Text>
            {/if}
          {/if}
        </Box>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
